notes.title: 9/19 Update Information
notes.content:
The following changes have been made in the 2.4.0.1 update, released 9/19.
[b]
1. Addition of Ethereal Weapons[/b]
Three types of ethereal weapons have been added: Jet Axe, Missile Cannon, and Laser Rifle.

Ethereal Weapons cannot be duplicated, but if you are lucky enough to obtain one during exploration, you'll find them to be quite powerful.
Stay on the lookout during your exploration. If you find one, you'll be able to overwhelm your enemies. 

[b]2. Addition of Ethereal Relics[/b]
A new relic, "Cannonball Launcher," has been added, which can afflict enemies with shock.

The newly added "Cannonball Launcher" is a relic that fires an energy sphere that applies the shock effect to enemies every two seconds.
Ethereal relics cannot be duplicated.

[b]3. Event[/b]
In celebration of our participation in TGS, we've made a few changes to Galaxy Mode for a limited time.

Through the end of the current season, environments and bosses that appear in Czerny, Symphonia, and Campanella will be randomized, rather than fixed to those respective galaxy campaigns.

In addition, during the event period, VP and in-game item drop rates will be doubled, so don't miss out!

[b]4. Bug Fixes and Improvements[/b]
Removed recovery limiting effects from Explosive type weapons.
Fixed a problem in PvP where the score is reduced when a player leaves the game in the middle of a match.

notes.title: Version 2.2.0.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
The following updates and bug fixes are addressed in this patch.

[b]◆Updates[/b]
[b]1. Season Challenge Improvements
[/b]Improved discovery of Relic Boxes from the Season Challenge lobby map.
All relics now appear in the Season Challenge and can be duplicated.
We have increased the rewards that can be obtained at the start of the Season Challenge and slightly reduced the rewards that can be obtained later.

[b]2. Relics
[/b]Increased damage for explosion, ion, and plasma relics.
Critical hit damage from Critical Boxes has been reduced.
Upgraded the Counter Defender
We have enhanced offensive capabilities while also increasing HP, making it a fundamental component in survival setups.

[b]3. Matchmaking Improvements
[/b]We've improved random matchmaking so that you'll be taken directly to the matchmaking lobby when you're matched with 2 or more players.
Even if you are matched with 2 players and go to the matching lobby, you may be matched with 1 additional player before you start.
Multiplayer difficulty now automatically adjusts to the number of players in the game.

[b]4. Breaker Balance Adjustments
[/b]Jungler
> Nerfed [Explosive Mine] damage
Bronte
> Nerfed the cooldown for [Detonate] and changed its buff effects.
   *Before: Increase skill power by 50% for 5 seconds on use (triggers every 3 seconds)
   *After: [Detonate] cooldown reduced by 20%
> [Eye of the Plasma] buff changes
*Before: [Eye of the Plasma] duration extended by 50%, pull-in strength increased by 100%, and when activated, increases damage by 50% against shocked enemies for 10 seconds.
*After: [Eye of the Plasma] duration extended by 50%, pull-in strength increased by 100%.
*Before: Using [Eye of the Plasma] increases skill power by 100% for 5 seconds. Disables all status effects.
*After: [Eye of the Plasma] increases damage against shocked enemies by 50% for 10 seconds, and immunity to all status effects.

[b]5. Weapons
[/b]Damage and passive effects nerfs to the Missile Launcher
Critical damage adjusted from 100% to 50%

[b]6. Other
[/b]Improvement so that 1~2 tier weapons have a 50% chance of dropping when defeating a boss in all galaxies and Season Challenges.
Increased the drop rate to earn more SP.
Added function to adjust the volume of the operator's voice in the settings.
Added the ability to change the language of the operator's voice.
Adjusted the duration of the Toy Worker's buff to be shorter.

[b]◆Bug Fixes
[/b]Fixed a problem where Rush could not deal damage with radiation weapons after using the [Sand Beam] skill.
Fixed a problem where survival skills were included in the ability to reset all skill cooldowns.
Fixed a problem where the detailed information icon of the relic was displayed in white.
If the corresponding icon is not displayed, it will be displayed normally after resetting your shortcut settings and reapplying the relic.

We plan to continue improving ANVIL and add operators in various languages. Please look forward to the addition of operators.
Thank you for your continued support of ANVIL

notes.title: Version 2.1.0.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello Breakers,

First off, you probably noticed the version number is 2.1.0.0. Well, that's because the official release was actually 2.0. (Sorry, some stuff got lost in translation ^^; ) So moving forward, builds will increase from this number.

That said, it’s been only half a day since release, but we have some fixes already! We continue to appreciate everyone for your support in helping to bring these bugs to our attention, as we continue to iron them out.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an audio-related crash issue.
[*] Fixed a problem where if the game is forcibly terminated during the timer after PvP matching, the opposing player becomes unable to progress the game.
[*] Fixed an issue where the difficulty selection screen is repeated when matchmaking is conducted in a Season Challenge.
[*] Decreased the reload time of the Venom Rifle.
[*] Decreased the duration of the Lightning's "Homing Laser" skill by 50% and doubled its power.
[*] *The above effects also apply to lasers added by the skill enhancement effect.
[*] Decreased the damage of Draken's Hack and Slash.
[*] Volume adjustment of some SE sounds that were too loud
[*] Fixed a problem where the wrong skill sound was applied in some parts of Valkyrie's skills.
[*] Fixed a problem where rankings were not being recorded in multiplayer.

[/list]
We're also aware of the following bugs, which we’re working on.
[list]
[*] Issue where Rush can't deal damage with radiant-type weapons after using the "Sand Beam" skill.
[/list]
In addition to the above, we’ve optimized PvP to play more smoothly.

notes.title: ANVIL Releases on Steam today!
notes.content:
Vault Breakers, welcome to the Ancient Vault Investigation Lab (ANVIL).

Suit up, and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1487390/ANVIL/]download ANVIL on the store page today[/url]! 
[b][CELEBRATE LAUNCH WITH 25% off through Aug 3!][/b]
To further celebrate the release we're giving out 5000 Crons!
To redeem, just head to "Coupon Code" in the menu, and enter "ANVILWORLD"!

A huge thanks to all of you who have supported us through Early Access and helped make this launch possible!

[b]Some of the new features in Version 1.0 include:[/b]
[list]
[*] Take on other breakers in PVP mode.
[*] An Artificial Intelligence companion “I.O,” English voice by Erin Yvette* (Oxenfree, Genshin Impact, The Walking Dead), Japanese voice by Saki Fujita (Attack on Titan, Kantai Collection, YuruYuri)
[*] A new Breaker, Valkyrie, a supporter who can summon a Titan that can flip the odds in your teams’ favor.
[*] A new weapon crafting system
[*] New Toy Workers
[*] New Relics
[*] Balance adjustments
[/list]
[b]Also in 1.0, a number of bug have been addressed, including:[/b]
Fixed an issue where you could not leave the party after forming one for multiplayer.
Fixed an issue where, if the enemy attacked when they were too far away to see, you wouldn't see the attack but still receive damage.
Fixed an issue where objects would penetrate through some maps.
Fixed an object that made the player invisible without a see-through effect.
Fixed an issue where the breaker may float in the air when moving.
Other issues have been fixed.
[i]Please note that Steam achievements will be reset with this update[/i]

*English voice only available in English version of the game

Find co-op groups and join the discussion on our [url=https://discord.gg/AvxZVA65XB]Discord[/url].
Stay up to date on the latest news by following our [url=https://twitter.com/ANVIL_ACTION2]Twitter[/url].

ANVIL is a top-down sci-fi roguelike action shooter in which you control the Vault Breakers, an elite team of planetary explorers tasked with seeking out Vaults containing priceless ancient relics throughout the galaxy.

Whether you like to shoot from a distance, or get up and personal, each Breaker features unique combat abilities, allowing for a wide variety of play styles. More than 100 randomly generated artifacts and dozens of weapons make every run different from the last.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/6bc53d9df60c915dced8fc7640f49fe5e4d8287a.png[/img][i]The Titan-summoning Valkyrie[/i]

notes.title: Season 3 patch note
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

Here is the patch note for Season 3.
The patch will go live next week, so make sure to claim rewards for this season if you haven't already!!!

[h1]Content[/h1]

[h2]Exploration mission[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/ec6ba08567092d4b8584b2fb27da996ad0e1e306.jpg[/img]

A mission will be given each day, each week to explore a specific galaxy with a specific Breaker. A certain amount of Crons will be given as a reward.
[list]
[*] Daily mission reset time will be 00:00 UTC each day
[*] Weekly mission consists of a 5-step mission and will reset every Monday at 00:00 UTC.
[*] Missions may fail to operate if local device time is changed to abuse the system.
[/list]
[h2]Toy worker research[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/4b6fd62f22fedcd197930077c369138ca80ca23b.png[/img]

A system where you can give different abilities and upgrade your toy worker using Crons has been added.
[list]
[*] Toy worker research can be done from the toy worker menu in the main lobby
[/list]
Toy worker modification
[list]
[*] Each toy worker has 4 option slots and each slot can be modified to be given a random effect
[*] Slots and effects have unique types associated with them and having the right type for a slot and effect can affect upgrades.
[/list]
Toy worker upgrade
[list]
[*] Effects obtained through toy worker modification can be upgraded up to 10 times
[*] Toy worker’s default ability starts at max level (10).
[/list]
Toy worker rank and bonus
[list]
[*] The rank of a toy worker is decided by the sum of the level of its options. High rank can grant bonus attack damage.
[/list]
Resetting limit
[list]
[*] Each time a toy worker is modified/upgraded, the toy worker's limit value increases. When the limit reaches 100%, you can no longer modify or upgrade the toy worker.
[*] You can reset the limit using the reset feature. This does not cost any Crons, but all options given to the toy worker will be reset.
[/list]
[h2]Tutorial[/h2]
A tutorial that runs through the game system and content has been added.
[list]
[*] You can turn the tutorial off on the pop-up menu for it to stop appearing. You can reset the tutorial option in-game to see it again.
[/list]
[h2]Season reward[/h2]

The previous season pass has been renamed to season reward. With the new season, the rewards have been renewed and the season rank has been reset

[h2]Challenge[/h2]

The challenge rewards have been changed to Crons instead of relics. The Challenge level will be been reset.

Challenge-exclusive relics now appear in galaxy explorations.

[h1]Battle[/h1]

Breaker balance adjustments: Many Breakers’ skill upgrades have been changed or enhanced for balance.

Affected Breakers
[list]
[*] Lightning, Liner, Draken, Mountain, Rush, Toast, Quake, Uzi, Shuri, Bronte
[/list]
Some boss monsters have new animation phases added after the attack pattern
[list]
[*] Affected boss monsters: Sandshark, Windshark, Mountain Kraken, Arma X, Cyclops, Khazard Armor
[/list]
[h1]System[/h1]

[h3]Game mode now available upon previous mode completion[/h3]

New players need to clear the practice mode to explore different galaxies or the season challenge mode.

[h3]Ranking system renewal[/h3]

Czerny, Symphonia, Campanella, Campanella Extreme, and Season Challenge ranking now have independent rankings with each having single-play and co-op play ranking.

[h1]Visual[/h1]

[h3]UI design improvements[/h3]

UI design for relic chests, Vaulty’s shop, and Skill upgrade device among others have been changed.

[h3]Change to game main lobby design[/h3]

The main lobby now has a new design

[h3]Change to Challenge lobby design[/h3]

The Challenge lobby now has a new design

[h3]Obelisk design change and effect improvement[/h3]

Obelisks that appear in-game have design updates and destruction effect change and update

[h1]Technical[/h1]

[h3]Intel XeSS(Xe Super Sampling) support[/h3]

You can turn this feature on in the game option under the video tab.

[h1]Bugs[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed frame rate dropping when language is changed to Thai.
[*] Fixed server being disconnected sometimes during multiplayer mode.
[*] Fixed Keyboard/mouse control environment not allowing leaving parties despite clicking on leave party.
[*] Fixed the icon for relics and rewards in Season reward and challenge appearing as if vertically elongated.
[*] Fixed Liner appearing to not hold a weapon when Missile Launcher skill is used when having blade type weapon.
[*] Fixed decoys created with skills such as teleport not damaging the enemies as they should
[*] Fixed reducing debuff duration not acting as it should when it reached over 100%
[*] Fixed typo in Exerium defense suit description.
[*] Fixed option information in dropped weapons not changing when language is changed.
[*] Fixed zephyr gatling weapon fire graphic effect and actual hit box being different in multiplayer mode.
[*] Fixed “Recover 3 rounds of ammo per second” being on weapon more than once.
[*] Fixed Exit / Select button not showing up in the game lobby when selecting play mode.
[*] Fixed walk speed being reduced to 0 not applying correctly in the game lobby when using gatling gun
[*] Fixed awkward effects when Breaker skill effect motion ends.
[*] Fixed Jungler’s Bullet Slash skill upgrade “Apply burn on hit” being applied in repetition with another burn application effect.
[*] Fixed the camera move speed gradually increasing when using survival skill while movement speed is increased.
[/list]

notes.content:
The new patch is now live!

[*] A blade coated with a poisonous substance. Striking an enemy 10 times inflicts poison.

[*] Desert and Jungle map environment effect improved

[*] The effect applied to the weapon the “Applies bleeding to all enemies” has been changed from tier 1 to tier 2

[*] Breaker UI for the Thai language being incorrectly shown for Breaker skill tab has been fixed
[*] Relic King of Heart has been changed to King of Diamond

[*] Max Season point available changed from 174 to 186. Maxing out all the trees is now possible. 12 season points will be rewarded to all players

[*] Directional icon showing fallen ally location in multiplayer mode being incorrectly shown has been fixed
[*] Effects that can only be applied once on weapons being applied twice in Season Challenge mode weapon option change system has been fixed
[*] When using upgrade system, the connecting lines being a different color than intended has been fixed

[/list]
[h1]Others[/h1]

[*] A stricter system to remove cheaters has been set in place
- As we announced in our official Discord and Twitter, those players using 3rd party programs and manipulating game data will be warned and can be removed from gameplay
[*] Rankings will be reset with the update
[*] A new button in the title menu leads to the official Discord.
- A QR Code that leads to the Discord will be shown on Xbox
[/list]

notes.title: [Dev Blog] May 31, 2022
notes.content:
Hello, this is Wonho Son, PD of Anvil.

Today, I want to talk about the upcoming changes for the season pass.
Starting Season 2, the premium season pass will disappear from the season pass. Everyone will be able to play up to level 100 without the need for purchase, and the rewards will be improved.
We will not be selling the premium season pass until we are a more complete game for 1.0 release. That said, we might add some skins as DLC for purchase, but these will not affect gameplay in any way unlike the V2 Toy Workers.

We will be adding much content in Season 2 that will make increase player satisfaction.
Here is a list of some of the features added.
[list]
[*] Improvements to Season Challenge Mode
[*] Ability to adjust relic appearance probability
[*] Relic preset given to beginners when they start
[*] Swordsman Breaker added
[*] Private code-based invite system (Allows for cross invite between Xbox and Steam)
[/list]
Many more features will be added to make the game more enjoyable and easier to access.

We are also currently fixing the issues that appeared with the May update.
We could perform a hotfix patch to quickly solve an issue at a time, but these quick patches could cause other additional issues so we will delay the update until Season 2 update for better stability.
We appreciate your understanding.

We will constantly strive to make Anvil a better game.
Thank you.

notes.title: [Dev Blog] Q&A session follow up
notes.content:
Hi, this is Jang, Project Manager for Anvil.

We listed answers and added further explanations to the questions we got last week, both before and during the live stream.
If you have further questions, ask on our Discord, and we’ll try to respond individually.
Thank you.

[h2]Live Q&A[/h2]

1.	Can you make the Season Challenge mode one difficulty and give three options?
[list]
[*] The Season Challenge mode is in its first stage. We will adjust in Season 2 where the difficulty selection and map selection will be separated. We are thinking of more ways to make it more fun and will progressively add features.
[/list]
2.	Any new biomes in the works?
[list]
[*] Rather than introducing new resources, we are more focused on better presentation of current planets.
[/list]
3.	Plans to buff Toast?
[list]
[*] The rework will come in Season 2, late May at the earliest, probably in June. Other Breaker to rework is up in the air. If you have suggestions, share with us on Discord!
[/list]
4.	Are there plans to add what the different icons on the maps in Season Challenge mode mean?
[list]
[*] We will add them.
[/list]
5.	Monsters are immune to the status effect of their planets. Are Breakers going to have the same immunity to their basic status skills in the future?
[list]
[*] Great suggestion and definitely possible.
[*] We are contemplating on ways for Breakers to grow stronger in phases. For example, Elsa being immune to freeze in her second form can be possible.
[/list]
6.	Can you make Campanella Hard/ Extreme available for single play?
[list]
[*] We are going to change the matching availability. Random matching will be available only in Season Challenge Mode, and in other galaxies, multiplayer mode will only be available in premade parties (cross platform invite added).
[*] With this change, Campanella Hard / Extreme will be available for single player mode.
[/list]
7.	Is an infinite mode in the works?
[list]
[*] Infinite mode is a must component for a roguelike game like Anvil. We will make players feel rewarded with Czerny, Symphonia and Campanella clears and change Season Challenge mode so that rank can increase without limit.
[/list]
8.	Can you tell us more about Swordman type Breaker?
[list]
[*] We hope to show him with our May preview update, may be delayed to June. It will be the first to use the melee weapon sword and shooter types will have access to swords as well. Fighter types cannot use the sword, but we plan to add new legendary hammer and axe.
[/list]
9.	Is season 2 coming in June?
[list]
[*] We expect the due date to be late June.
[/list]
10.	Have you considered maps for 5+ players?
[list]
[*] We tried having maps with over 10 people engaged in PVP but have many considerations to make regarding how to make the experience more fun. Right now, we are more focused on game stability and development of new modes is lower in priority. Having too many people in screen is also not suitable for Anvil, so many things are in consideration.
[/list]
11.	Can boss kills account for more stacks for knife relics?
[list]
[*] Great idea. We’ll consider it in the future.
[/list]
12.	Comment on build diversity?
[list]
[*] We are thinking of a different system to increase player choice than just skill/weapon power build and status effect build.
[/list]
13.	Any changes to skill point system?
[list]
[*] We are thinking of many convenient UI changes such as ability to put in many points at once. We are thinking of a more simplified form that can complement Breakers.
[/list]
14.	Any information on upcoming skins?
[list]
[*] Skins will be constantly added. The basic skins are in game. The skins in the future will be much more interesting.
[/list]

[h2]Prior questions[/h2]
1.	Are there plans to increase the player limit?
[list]
[*] We are developing a cross platform invite system. When it’s done, the player limit will also be removed. For example, 3-player run in Czerny or 2-player run in Campanella will be possible. Also, the change in difficulty depending on number of players will be more transparent in the UI. For increasing player limit to up to 4, there are a lot of issues to consider and is under review.
[/list]
2.	Are there plans to change the status effect system? There seems to be little value beside the status effect target and the two useful status effects.
[list]
[*] We are discussing ways to change the system, but have yet to decide whether to overhaul everything or make partial improvements. The status effect in Anvil allows for big burst of damage for a duration. The key will be whether we change this mechanism or maintain this concept.
[/list]
3.	Are there plans to tell newcomers of systems in the game such as what status effects do and how the boss immunity works?
[list]
[*] We are trying to lower the entry barrier and make the game more convenient / intuitive. We are discussing implementing tutorials or guided play and will be applied within the year.
[/list]
4.	Can you share any other information after the run such as total damage dealt?
[list]
[*] It’s possible, but how to make use of such information remains up in the air. We have no immediate plans to add this.
[/list]
5.	What happened to the plans for trinity relics?
[list]
[*] The initial roadmap had trinity relics that can replace breaker skills to other ones. Right now, we are more focused on stabilizing the game and reinforcing the core gameplay. As such, adding new features has been delayed.
[/list]
6.	Can you change so that homing projectiles don’t disappear when hitting off walls?
[list]
[*] We consider them disappearing when hitting visible walls is within game rules. Them disappearing when hitting invisible objects is a bug that we plan to fix.
[/list]
7.	Is damage cancelling when reloading a bug?
[list]
[*] We have identified the bug and will fix next patch.
[/list]
8.	Is a combined ranking for Steam and Xbox coming?
[list]
[*] We are having technical problems with a combined ranking system. It will take a while before it is implemented.
[/list]
9.	Are there plans for PlayStation release?
[list]
[*] It is under review, but nothing is set in stone. The Switch release is in the works.
[/list]
10.	Will all Breakers have passives like Elsa and Guillotine?
[list]
[*] Breaker passives were added to make their characteristics more unique. While all Breakers will be developed to be more unique, we cannot say that every single one will get a passive. If the Breaker is unique enough without a passive, we may not give it one.
[/list]
11.	Is there an end direction or goal to make the game more of a diverse experience?
[list]
[*] The goal of Early Access for Anvil was increasing content. We wanted to add things to do, chance to set goals and input growth factors. But we determined that we lack the basics right now. The priority is stabilizing the game. Also, the core gameplay of acquiring relics to create builds is too disfigured. All contents within the game are not harmonious and sends mixed signals. The development team is aware of this and is trying to make Anvil a roguelike action shooter that is fun to play. We will organize scaling and reexamine key points in the game that make the gameplay fun, including relic builds.
[/list]
12.	Are there ways to add Breaker points besides the Season Pass and Season challenge rewards?
[list]
[*] Use the coupon “ROGUELIKE” to redeem 10 BP.
[/list]

notes.title: [Dev Blog] April 19, 2022
notes.content:
Hello, this is Wonho Son.

Today, I want to talk about the April update as well as the “Going Rogue: A Festival of Persistence” coming up in May on Steam. 

[h2]April update[/h2]

[h3]The goal of the April update is stability.[/h3]
[list]
[*] We focused on solving major crash issues and bugs.
[*] Game stability will also be the top priority in development as we move forward.
[/list]
[h3]Guillotine and Elsa revamped[/h3]
[list]
[*] Breaker revamp will occur with every update. It won’t be just increasing the numbers but in a way that strengthens the unique aspect of the Breaker.
[*] Guillotine’s concept as an executioner will be highlighted, with increasing critical damage with every kill.
- Other stats have been increased and the synergy with critical hits has been amplified.
[*] Elsa’s summoned beasts are much stronger
- The duration and damage have increased, as well as more synergy when enemies are frozen.
[/list]
[h3]The April update will arrive on April 26 on both Steam and Xbox.[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rankings will be rest with every monthly update.
[/list]

[h2]Steam Roguelike festival![/h2]

“Going Rogue: A Festival of Persistence” will be starting on May 2, in which ANVIL will be participating. During the festival period, we will show streamers playing our game as well as Dev Q&A.

[h3]Season Challenge mode rework[/h3]

[list]
[*] Season Challenge mode that was added in Season 1 fits the direction of ANVIL than the existing galaxies.
[*] The dev team is contemplating different ways to make the season challenge more enjoyable and is trying to implement it when Season 2 arrives.
[*] As to increasing the max season challenge level that I mentioned previously, the development tests showed that the increase in stats led to increase in monster’s HP and defense amounts. This in turn resulted in some bosses to become bullet sponges, which many players complained about in the past. As such, we are thinking of different ways to make the game more challenging without the battle drawing out. We will share more details when we have things are set in stone.
[/list]

notes.title: Season 1 update patch note (Update date: March 30, 2022)
notes.content:
[h2]ANVIL’s official season begins[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/9f77baac70e27beabd278c911fd7d00f1e6f263f.png[/img]

[h2]New mode : Season Challenge added[/h2]

In the new game mode, Season Challenge, players can choose the difficulty and the opponent to fight against. With the ability to change weapon effects and upgrade/sell relics, players can have a much more interesting run in the direction they want to build. In addition, in the Season Challenge mode, alert-level wave monsters do not appear.

[h3]Choosing planets to explore[/h3]
[list]
[*] Season Challenge consists of 10 planet selections.
[*] You will choose one of the three planets with varying difficulty to proceed to through a vote.
[*] The difficulty level is accumulative, and the final reward is given based on the final clear level.
[/list]
[h3]Obelisk[/h3]
[list]
[*] Obelisks that drop tons of resources (coins) will appear randomly in the field.
[/list]
[h3]Challenge completion reward[/h3]
[list]
[*] In Galaxy> Season Challenge Menu, you can redeem your season challenge rewards
[*] Reward is given based on the final level of the planet you cleared.
[/list]
[h3]Weapon modification[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can add additional effects to weapons or change existing ones. 
[*] In-game resources(coins) are consumed on change and the cost gradually increases. (resets when the planet is cleared)
[/list]
[h3]Relic upgrade / selling[/h3]
[list]
[*] Stack-based relics can be upgraded to the next level
[*] Relics that aren’t needed can be sold. 
[/list]
[h3]Season Challenge ranking[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now check season challenge exclusive ranking in the ranking menu
[*] Combined single/multiplayer rankings are shown
[*] Rank per individual Breaker will be shown later on
[/list]
[h3]Season Challenge badge[/h3]
[list]
[*] The final cleared Challenge level will be indicated as a badge next to your ID
[*] The badge shines more brightly as you achieve higher challenge levels.
[*] You can check other players’ badges in multiplayer mode.
[/list]
[h2]Regular Season Pass starts[/h2]

[h3]New season pass up to 100 ranks begins[/h3]
[list]
[*] 100 rank is easier to achieve compared to the preseason 
[/list]
[h3]Purchase of the premium pass comes with V2 Toy Worker that has activation skills[/h3]
[list]
[*] Medic V2: Periodically replenishes health. / Increase attack power based on max HP.
[*] Hive V2: Periodically shields breaker. / Increase attack when a shield is up.
[/list]
[h3]Compensation for duplicate rewards given.[/h3]
[list]
[*] For players already with Season Pass rewards, an appropriate amount of Crons will be given instead.
[/list]
[h2]New contents added[/h2]
[h3]New Breaker Quake officially released[/h3]

Acquisition
[list] 
[*] You can purchase using 1,000 Crons
[*] Can also be unlocked through the season challenge reward 
[/list]
Breaker balance adjustments
[list]
[*] Spiral punch and Tremor cooldown increase by 50%.
[*] Effect of Spiral Field has been changed. 
- When the skill is used, Quake hits the ground with spiral energy and pulls in enemies and petrifies them.

[*] Spiral Field’s skill upgrades have been changed.
- 100% increase to [Spiral Field] effect range and duration of petrification
- Enemies in [Spiral Field] receive 1000% of attack power as damage
- Enemies in [Spiral Field] receive 50% increased damage for 10 seconds
- Reduce the cooldown of [Spiral Field] by 30%
- Gain 5% of max HP for each enemy hit by [Spiral Field]
[/list]
[h3]4 new bosses added[/h3]
[list]
[*] 4 new bosses have been added and will appear in existing galaxies (Symphonia, Campanella Extreme) and Season Challenge mode.
[/list]
[h3]6 new weapons added[/h3]
[list]
[*] 6 powerful weapons that apply status effects have been added 
[*] You can check the new weapons in Lobby> Data.
[/list]
[h3]New appearance changing skins added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Special skins that greatly change the appearance of breakers have been added.
[*] New skins can be acquired through the Season Pass or through Crons.
[/list]
[h2]New features[/h2]

[h3]Breaker Points (BP) added[/h3]
[list]
[*] BP can be acquired through the Season Pass/ Season Challenge rewards
[*] BP will be used to upgrade Breaker suits in the future.
[*] In this season, BP can be used to change starting weapons or starting skill upgrades.
[/list]
[h3]Breaker starting weapon change[/h3]
[list]
[*] Each breaker can change their basic weapon to a different one.
[*] You can equip weapons in the Lobby> Breaker> Weapon tab.
[*] Only tier 1 weapons and certain weapons are available, but more weapons will be added.
[/list]
[h3]Upgrading Breaker’s basic skills[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can upgrade 1 skill in the Lobby>Breaker>Skill tab
[*] This allows you to customize your build in advance, making gameplay more interesting.
[/list]
[h3]Ultrawide monitor support[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changes have been made for smooth ultrawide monitor support
[*] The support is turned on by default and can be turned off in option>graphics
[/list]

[h2]Balance adjustments[/h2]

We made big adjustments to balance. We deleted many defensive relics and added new relics for more builds leaning toward offense. With many defensive builds unavailable, the attack power of enemies has been lowered. Many deaths that seemed unfair occur less frequently and the difficulty of battle is more reasonable.

[h3]Defensive relics are no longer available.[/h3]
[list]
[*] The defensive relics already replicated by players will remain. You can still equip these relics.
[*] With enemy attack decrease, the numbers on existing defense relics have been changed for balance. 
[*] New players will have a chance to acquire relics that are no longer available through events.
[/list]
[h3]Diverse offensive relics have been added[/h3]
[list]
[*] 10 Season exclusive tier 3 relics among other attack relics have been added 
[/list]
[h3]Enemy attack increase rate has been lowered[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed from a 3.5% increase per level to 1.5%
[*] In higher-level planets, this will be more noticeable. At 100 level, the attack will be lowered by 80% than before.
[/list]
[h3]We fixed a bug where effects that activate for under 30% max HP do not occur when a large amount of damage is received.
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Shield when HP is less than 30%, health recovery when HP is less than 30% and others that help avoid sudden death had an activation error which has now been fixed. These will activate just before death to protect players.
[/list] 
[h3]One-shot prevention buff has been added to all Breakers.[/h3]
[list]
[*] Breakers will become invulnerable for 5 seconds when HP falls lower than 10% (3 min cooldown) 
[*] This will block attacks that make health go below 0. (Although it triggers once every 3 min)
[/list]

We reinforced gameplay and made big changes to balance. The newly added Season Challenge mode is designed to let both new and veteran players enjoy the game by choosing the difficulty level. The new weapons are fun and strong. You can now change starting weapons and upgrade skills before a run, allowing presetting to have more impact. 

With the new season, we will continually try to become a better game. Thank you.

notes.title: [Dev Blog] Plowing ahead towards March update
notes.content:
Hello, this is Wonho Son, PD of ANVIL.

With COVID rampant across the globe, I am sure everyone is experiencing individual struggles. The dev team is also facing many problems, but we will work together to overcome this crisis. Although our development speed has slowed down a bit, we will continue to strive to become a more enjoyable game.

There have been many changes to the journey mode. Creating a new mode fit for the new season came with more challenges than expected, and while testing the gameplay, new ideas to improve it is constantly popping up, making many alterations.

The initial focus of the Journey mode was in “path selection,” but we are now leaning more toward “choosing your opponents” and “challenging yourself.” Thus, the Journey mode’s unofficial title has been changed to “Season Challenge.” By adding brand new features like new bosses, difficulty of your choosing, and new systems that help you improve your Breaker like weapon modification, relic upgrade/disposal among others, the new mode is coming out to be a different yet fun and exciting mode.

We are also constantly working on fixing bugs and making the game more stable. We had a couple of updates through server patches that we hoped would fix the problems but there are still major issues that are unresolved. We are trying to make sure we solve this problem so that it does not reoccur, but this is taking longer than we anticipated.

We are working hard to keep our promise of what we planned for the March update.

Thank you.

notes.title: Feb. Update patch note
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The Feb. update can be considered a preseason update before the Season update in March.
Players will be able to test out a new Breaker in advance and progress along the Season Pass more quickly with the boost-up event in place.

[h3]New Breaker Quake open-testing period[/h3]

Players will be able to play Quake with the Feb. update. Quake will be available for free until the March update, so we hope to receive diverse feedback. Quake will have balancing adjustments before his official release in March and his skill effects and outward appearance will be upgraded.
He will be an official Breaker with the Season 1 update in late March.
 
[h3]New weapon Drill Gauntlet added[/h3]

Quake’s basic weapon Drill Gauntlet will be added to the weapon drop pool. Drill Gauntlets with new special effects will be added in future updates.
 
[h3]Season Pass VP experience boost up[/h3]

VP experience gained leading up to the Season 1 update will be doubled.
Once the new season starts, the preseason Season Pass will no longer be available.
 
[h3]UI for galaxy season challenge mode added[/h3]

The new mode UI that will be available in March has been added in advance.
(The new mode will be unable to enter and will be available for play in Season 1)
Please look forward to the season exclusive challenge mode! 
 
[h3]Improvements to relic effects[/h3]

Some relic effects have been altered so that similar build stats do not decrease.
 
Concussive Rounds  
[list]
[*] Previous effect 	: 50% weapon power increase, 30% attack speed decrease
[*] Changed effect	: 50% weapon power increase, 20% skill power decrease
[/list]

Necklace of Amplification
[list]
[*] Previous effect	: 50% skill power increase, 20% skill cooldown increase
[*] Changed effect	: 50% skill power increase, 20% weapon power decrease
[/list]
[h3]Changes to UI[/h3]

We are adjusting the UI in the long-term, leading up to full release. We will improve visual effects step by step every update to provide better user experience. 
We are currently changing the layout of UI in the lobby in preparation of new contents coming out in the future. This will proceed step-by-step every update.
 
Setting – Key change
We had an issue with the Esc key being unable to be registered in key change settings, so we decided to change the key selection process in settings.
To avoid confusion among players, we tried to make fewest changes possible, but making confirm/cancel key change to enter/esc is now possible.

Other changes in basic key settings include

Smart Ping: Shift -> 1 
Emoticon 1: 1 -> 2
Emoticon 2: 2 -> 3
Emoticon 3: 3 -> 4
Press to Speak: V -> Shift
Go to left tab: G -> C
Go to right tab: H -> V

* We are trying to make all the keyboard interaction possible with just one hand.  

[h3]Others[/h3]

There were some issues with the Gold Hound distribution coupon, so we decided to give out Gold hound to everyone without the need of a coupon. 
 
We fixed the issue where matchmaking would go on forever with no end.
We made fixes to solve blackscreen error.

We changed the laser effect range of certain boss monsters showing differently than how it is. 

We added UI and effects so that success and failure of exploration is more apparent.
 
Monster pathing logic has been updated so the tracking of Breakers by enemies is smoother.

Xbox rankings will be refreshed.

notes.title: Jan. update details
notes.content:
Hello, this is Wonho Son, PD of ANVIL. 

The main content of the Jan. update is the addition of different galaxy difficulty levels. We want to explain our intentions as well as give details. 
 
[h2]Galaxy difficulty diversification [/h2]

We added Czerny practice mode so newcomers can play the game in a more friendly environment. We greatly decreased the difficulty level and gave starting gold to allow players to create builds more easily. However, to avoid difficulty in matchmaking due to having separate matchmaking pools, we will only make Czerny practice mode available as single player mode. 

The current Campanella galaxy difficulty level will be set as the highest (Extreme), and two less difficult modes, normal and hard will be added. As clearing Campanella normal opens the fourth relic spot, we expect people can take advantage of this to clear Campanella Hard and Extreme more easily. 

Specifically regarding Campanella Extreme, players will start out with 500 gold, allowing players to buy tier-3 weapons or with multiple relics. We hope players don’t see this mode as just a difficult mode but get a sense of “extreme” feeling and have fun. In addition, the number of planets will be increased to 9 and will have random bosses besides the two fixed ones, making a different play experience than the current Campanella structure. 

The thing we were most concerned about for making many difficulties available was that with matching spots diversified, the time for matchmaking can become longer. To solve this issue, we decided this difficulty addition can be a mid-way solution and will constantly improve based on user feedback and stats. 

Also, we deleted base status effect resistance of bosses so players can make use of status effects more and made diverse changes to controls and battle visual effects so that players do not experience unexpected deaths. Furthermore, we made fixing bug and crash issues an utmost priority and was able to fix many of them. 

We thank you for all your interest and support. We will strive to repay everyone by becoming a better game. Thank you. 

[h1]January update details [/h1]

[h2]Diversification of galaxy difficulty [/h2]

Czerny Practice (Single player) 
[list]
[*] Game description and guide added 
[*] No alert level monsters appear 
[*] Difficulty level decrease by 25% overall 
[*] 150 starting gold added 
[*] Clearing the practice mode will not open Symphonia or the 2nd relic slot 
[*] Relic replication percentage is the same, but only 50% of VP earned compared to Czerny normal mode. 
[/list]
Campanella Normal (3 people) 
[list]
[*] Difficulty level decrease by 25% overall compared to previous Campanella 
[*] Clearing Campanella Normal unlocks the 4th relic slot 
[/list]
Campanella Hard (3 people) 
[list]
[*] Difficulty level decrease by 10% overall compared to previous Campanella 
[*] Relic replication percentage is the same, but VP earned increased by 25% compared to Campanella Normal. 
[/list]
Campanella Extreme (3 people) 
[list]
[*] Consists of 9 planets 
[*] Random boss monster spawn besides fixed boss monsters stages 
[*] Players start with 500 gold 
[*] While other stats are equal to the previous Campanella mode, monsters have 30% faster attack speed and movement speed 
[*] Relic replication percentage is the same, but VP earned increased by 50% compared to Campanella Normal. 
[/list]
[h2]Battle improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Players can now cancel Breaker skill using dash, shield, teleport etc. 
[*] Players can use survival skills (dash, shield, teleport etc.) when silenced 
[*] Fighter type Breakers no longer have cooldown for shields 
- Players can now use shield immediately 
[*] Improvements and changes to counterattack 
- Invulnerability after counterattack increased by 0.5 seconds 
- Range of enemy projectile destruction after counterattack doubled 
- Guillotine and Toast’s counterattack damage doubled 
- Counterattack now has an internal cooldown (excluding Toast) 
[*] Screen shake increase depending on damage has been added 
[*] Knockback on weapon fire that was added for hit effect has been removed 
- Effect only remains for Assault Handgun that had it as default effect 
[*] Decrease to alert level effect that increased attack and defense
 - Attack increase by 50% / Defense by 100% -> Attack 30% / Defense 50%
- The silver shining shading effect has been removed as it was the same effect as Polychopper reflect. An appropriate shader will be added in the future
[/list]
[h2]Status effect improvements [/h2]
[list]
[*] Status effect (freeze, burn etc.) on bosses now shown under boss health bar 
- Status effect icon images change for more visibility 
- Status effects blink for 3 seconds prior to removal 
[*] Boss base resistance changed from 50% to 0% 
- Ex) Previously, freeze lasted 5 sec on normal monsters and 2.5 sec on boss monsters 
- After change, boss monsters are also frozen for 5 sec 
[*] Shock duration changed form 15 sec to 7 sec 
- Fixed error where shock / bleed effect was not among boss resistance system 
[*] Fixed error when all bosses were not immune to stun 
- Fixed issue where battle pattern overlapped, allowing for clearer response to battle patterns 
[*] Visual effects of status effects such as shock, burn etc. improved to be more noticeable. 
[/list]
[h2]Emoticon added [/h2]
[list]
[*] Use of emoticon in matching lobby and in-game through the cross key on Game pad (1,2,3 on keyboard) added 
- Smile, tears, cold face 
- This update only provides basic features and will be enforced later with more diverse emoticons that can be edited 
[*] Button added after clearing galaxy instead of immediately going to stats page 
- Use the new emotes to complement each other! 
[/list]
[h2]Additional improvements [/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved alert level so that visual effect does not hinder battle visibility 
[*] Thai, Italian, and Vietnamese language added 
[*] Added screen shake control in settings 
[*] Changed “damage increase” and “damage decrease” on HUD to “+” and “–“ due to character length 
[*] Physical attack effect added to all monsters 
[*] Visual improvements to Root Guardian cannon barrage projectile skill so it can be seen more clearly 
[*] Crasher shotgun’s passive effect “Increase critical chance on use” added to description 
[*] Some gauntlet, gatling gun, etc. weapon animation effect added 
[*] Bonus relic stack effect from 3rd relic onward added in green letters 
[/list]
[h2]Major bug fixes [/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where players were locked out of boss lairs 
[*] Fixed where some skill effects remained when moving on to the next planet (Elsa ultra beam, etc.) 
[*] Fixed numerical value not appearing in upgrades for Chinese traditional / simplified 
[*] Fixed issue where Season Pass Rank would go up abnormally 
[*] Fixed issue of camera going off center when spectating allies after death 
[*] Fixed issue where 4 players could enter 3 people galaxies 
[*] Fixed major crash issues 
[*] Fixed certain relics not appearing in the Vaulty’s shop 
[*] Fixed where system asks to enter a coupon code on Game pad after entering a coupon 
[*] Fixed where monsters summoned by the Root Guardian remained after boss is defeated 
[*] Fixed issue where Sandman’s skill upgrade “decrease defense of enemies hit by 100%” was not applied correctly 
[*] Fixed issue where Sandman’s skill upgrade “increase weapon power when grenade lands” was not applied correctly 
[*] Fixed instance on Game pad where cannons fired toward the last aimed direction 
[*] Fixed issue where passive skill of gatling gun remained even after changing weapons 
[/list]
[h2]Other issues [/h2]
[list]
[*] Rankings will reset on both Xbox and Steam with the Jan. update 
[*] Uzi and Bronte skins that show their face have been added (Uzi: 300 Crons, Bronte: 200 Crons) 
[/list]
[h2]Known bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] We are currently fixing an issue where Guillotine's Charge Skill does not deal damage to stationary boss monsters
[*] Some lasers not being shown when Boss Destroyer and Machine Magician uses a star shaped laser pattern. The damage is dealt up to the star's apexes so players need to move far away or go to the center. We are currently fixing this issue as soon as possible.
[*] The shining effect when Shuri is recharging cannon is excessive. We are fixing the issue.
[/list]

notes.title: Detailed Q&A answers
notes.content:
ANVIL Q&A

Questions received prior to Q&A session (excluding the ones mentioned during live stream)

1.	Plans for changes to status effects?
[list]
[*] We are testing many ways to improve the status effect interaction. The first step is to lower the status effect immunity of bosses from 50% to 0% which means the initial freeze will last the full duration of the status effect as it does to field monsters instead of half the time. We have many changes planned and will be applied step by step.
[*] As for shock being op, there was a bug where shock was excluded from status effect immunity. We have fixed that bug and we have further shortened the duration period of shock.
[/list]

2.	How are you going to diversify the Breaker builds?
[list]
[*] The current game version is the Early Access 1st version. There are many works in progress and many things will change, including the addition of relics and effects. Big changes will be coming in February and March at the latest.
[/list]

3.	Can you make an indication of relics that are already replicated in-game?
[list]
[*] We will add this to the development plans.
[/list]

4.	Do fighter-type weapons have a higher drop rate?
[list]
[*] No, it is just your misconception.
[/list]

5.	Any plans to change the stage that only has eggs?
[list]
[*] The intention was for it to be a stage that ties Breakers so that time passes, leading to higher difficulty. However, this led to boring gameplay. We are contemplating on how to change this stage to make it more meaningful yet different/unique.
[/list]

6.	Why can’t I stream on Xbox (Series S)?
[list]
[*] We will look into the issue.
[/list]

7.	Is Status Effect Target: 50% damage increase relic to enemies under status effect not appearing as frequently intended?
[list]
[*] We checked and it appears at the same rate.
[/list]

8.	The Xbox controller settings aren’t saved so I have to reset every time I log in. Can you make the settings last?
[list]
[*] We will make this a priority. At the current development pace, we expect this to be available in February or March.
[/list]

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Q&A from Livestream (Check Youtube : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1mkQn-s4nPs&t=179s)

1.	Is Crasher shotgun side effect of giving 100% crit chance intended?
[list]
[*] Yes, it is intended. Previously it used to be 100% crit not for 5 seconds on use but at any time. We decided to nerf it to 5 seconds but in that process accidentally deleted the description of applying crit. We will further improve the description of the weapons. 
[*] Plans to change many weapons and update them are in progress.
[/list]

2.	Are there plans to show a stat page at the end to show who does more work?
[list]
[*] We had a blog post during the demo that asked whether we should show teammate DPS, to which many responded “no.”
[*] Showing everything from healing done, damage taken, monsters killed, shield amount and others will make stat sharing more meaningful and are considerations for the future. However, that feature needs more development. Every Breaker has a different role and is not all about DPS. At the current state, we feel just sharing teammate DPS would have more cons than pros. A possibility would be sharing DPS only among premade team members.
[/list]

3.	Plans for new skin?
[list]
[*] 12 different skins that change the outward appearance of Breakers are prepared. We are contemplating how to make these skins available. At the earliest, these skins can be added in January and will be provided in February and March at the latest.
[*] We will add the Uzi skin that showed her face to the Jan. update.
[/list]

4.	Xbox Steam cross-platform invite?
[list]
[*] We expect this feature will be available around March.
[/list]

5.	How do the calculations for Attack Power, Weapon Power, Skill Power, Defense Penetration, and other stats work?
[list]
[*] We feel this is something that we need to provide. Just sharing the calculations on a blog post is something that can be done relatively quickly. Showing the calculations in-game so that even players new to the game can see it is proving to be more difficult. As such, the information delivery is being delayed. We will share it as a blog post soon since many players want to know.
[/list]

6.	Will there be more rewards in the Season Pass in the next Season?
[list]
[*] We will add a lot more diverse skins that change outward appearance, not just changing colors.
[*] At the current state, there is only one way to acquire relics. We plan to add some key relics in the Season Pass to obtain. We are also open to putting starting weapons and starting skill upgrades that players need to acquire to change at the start.
[/list]

7.	Are there plans to balance out existing Breakers like the Jungler, Sandman patch?
[list]
[*] We are thinking of a spotlight renewal system, with the first two Breakers being Jungler and Sandman. We are closely inspecting the results of this patch. Based on the stats we get, it is possible that we make further changes.
[*] In both February and March, we will be making a rework of 1 or 2 Breakers each time like we did with Jungler and Sandman. Right now, only the Breakers that are popular are getting used.
[/list]

8.	Are there going to be more ways to obtain revives in the future?
[list]
[*] We are in the process of making revive as an added effect. For example, Uzi will have a passive effect called Phoenix that lets her revive once.
[*] We plan to make relics that revive a Breaker upon death as well as special weapons.
[/list]

9.	Are there plans to nerf Sand Shark and Wind Shark?
[list]
[*] As for bosses, we are looking at the game stats to decide whether to make changes to them. As for Sand Shark and Wind Shark, only certain Breakers have difficulty fighting them. For example, the bullets that bounce for Lightning get blocked by the wind walls which makes it difficult. But other Breaker stats show that the bosses are not skewed to one side so we have no plans to make adjustments. We will be happy to share these stats with the players.
[/list]

10.	Are there plans to make custom weapon color, bullet color, and other customization options available?
[list]
[*] Right now, we have a skin system in place. Having different skins is probably the way we’ll look at it. That said, we think customization and showing your character is important so we are thinking more alongside adding badges or having a cape that reflects the player. These elements will be handed out as diverse rewards.
[/list]

11.	More detail on Toy Worker 2.0?
[list]
[*] In the demos, we had Toy Workers that fought alongside the players but that was delayed off. We will make Toy Workers able to fight as well as add cool features like being able to revive teammates, drop health packs and give a major buff every few seconds.
[*] Right now, there aren’t many places to use Crons. In Toy Worker 2.0, Crons will be used to upgrade these Toy Workers and customize them.
[/list]

12.	Will we be able to have a separate upgrade tree for each Breaker?
[list]
[*] Yes, that feature will be available in March.
[/list]

13.	Plans to give us Gold Hound?
[list]
[*] The Gold Hound Toy Worker was planned to be a wishlist prize, but we haven’t hit that milestone yet. If we don’t reach that milestone, we will think of other ways to provide it. We also wanted to wait until Toy Worker 2.0 to revamp the Toy Worker and give a better one to everyone. If needed, giving the Gold Hound a special event soon is possible.
[/list]

14.	When will the January update take place?
[list]
[*] We need to pass Xbox certification so, at the earliest, it will happen Jan. 26, at the latest Jan. 28.
[/list]

15.	Are there plans to change Polychopper reflect pattern?
[list]
[*] Reflect pattern is a unique pattern for this boss monster. We don’t plan to take that away, but we will vamp up the visual effect that reflection is happening so that people are more aware.
[/list]

16.	Are there plans to change the healing of Protian Beast?
[list]
[*] This isn’t a bug, but we are thinking of adjusting so that the interaction seems less unfair. We will try to fix the healing amount for decoys and clones.
[/list]

17.	Any plans to change one-shot mechanics?
[list]
[*] We plan to make the one-shot mechanic more easily distinguishable and add more graphical features.
[*] In February we have our balance patch #1. Right now, we have a roguelike system where players increase both their defense and attack. If we remove a lot of defensive growth paths, the enemy attacks don’t need to scale as rapidly. We plan to make player growth more focused offensively to make it more fun and make boss attacks scale more linearly than exponentially.
[/list]

18.	Are there plans to make the maps and spawning more random?
[list]
[*] We are considering this and plan to apply it more on the Journey mode.
[/list]

19.	Why does this game not support 4 player mode?
[list]
[*] We tried 2~4 player modes during the demo and came to the conclusion that the top-down format that we have is suitable for up to 3 and feels way too clustered with 4 people. More people will be suitable for more open maps, not the zone type that we have right. But there seems to be no reason to block a 4-man premade party if they are willing to endure the clustering, so we are thinking positively about making this happen.
[/list]

20.	Any thoughts on endless wave mode or endless boss challenge?
[list]
[*] For sure. That is something we are considering.
[*] The main idea of the Journey mode is for players to choose their path and go deeper in the galaxy. By deeper, it also means harder in difficulty. We are thinking of a type of endless mode in this state where players can dive in endlessly.
[/list]

21.	Any thoughts of being able to sell weapons?
[list]
[*] Instead of selling weapons, we are thinking more about upgrading weapons. Right now, if Breakers of the same type are on the same team, if one Breaker sells the weapon, the teammate might be unhappy.
[/list]

22.	Any thoughts on having a dummy to test out Breaker damage in the lobby?
[list]
[*] We think this would be a good idea to have before the full release and will try to develop it soon.
[/list]

23.	Any thoughts on allowing players randomly matched to play together after a run?
[list]
[*] Something in consideration, but lower in our priority but good to have because we are focused more on the core roguelike play and Journey Mode. That said, we will try to implement this feature before the full launch. In addition, we also added the time after clearing the galaxy in the Jan. update for people to interact.
[/list]

24.	Thoughts on zooming out minimaps or changing minimap position?
[list]
[*] We don’t think zooming out the minimap is necessary, but changing the location of the minimap for convenience is something that will be put in the game.
[/list]

25.	What happens to the difficulty when a person leaves in the middle?
[list]
[*] The moment a player disconnects or leaves, the difficulty is instantly lowered to the remaining player number. 
[/list]

26.	Any thoughts on penalties for players who leave in the middle?
[list]
[*] Adding a penalty isn’t difficult, but we are trying to figure out what a reasonable penalty can be.
[*] Also, at the current state, the game isn’t 100% stable so the penalties will only be added when we are confident in our game stability. We plan for the game to be stable by March, so a penalty might be added then.
[/list]

Comments

As for the PVP mode, we want to make sure that this doesn’t change our game identity. We are contemplating what would be the best way to incorporate this into our game to make it more fun.

With four Season updates, we will continually make our game better. We will make it a game you can play and have fun and won’t give up on the game.

notes.title: ANVIL Early Access Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Thank you for tuning in to our live stream broadcast today.
Here are the details to the roadmap that we shared on stream.

To begin with, our first Season will begin in late March. Until then, we will have two monthly updates. one in January and one in February.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/580eb5d16edae2a9566f57e7bdfadf78567093a5.png[/img]


[h1]January Update[/h1]


[h2]Difficulty added[/h2]

In the January update, we will add three new difficulties that players can play.

[list]
[*] Czerny (Easy)
[*] Campanella (Normal)
[*] Campanella (Extreme)
[/list]
[h3]Czerny (Easy) [/h3]

[list]
[*] Act as a tutorial mode
[*] No Alert level system
[*] Many guides and messages to help clear the game
[/list]
[h3]Campanella (Normal)[/h3]

The current Campanella will be considered the Hard mode. 
A new Campanella normal mode will be added, which will allow players to clear the galaxy more easily.
the formatting will be the same, but boss health and other elements will be lowered.

[h3]Campanella (Extreme)[/h3]

A new mode called Campanella (extreme) will be available.
We don't want this to be just a very difficult mode, but a fun mode that people can have fun with.
[list]
[*] Players will start out with a set amount of resources to spend
[*] Bosses will be chosen at random from a pool of 7~9 Campanella bosses
[/list]
[h2]Battle UX improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Allow use of survival skill(dash, shield, teleport) during a skill
[*] Allow use of survival skill(dash, shield, teleport) when silenced
[*] Increase to invulnerability period after successful counterattack
[*] Ability to check relic stack effect from 3rd stack onward before purchase
[*] Status effect indication on boss health bar
[/list]

[h2]System improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Transition phase to stat page after clearing galaxy added
[*] Communication through icons added
[*] Improvements to alert level experience - more visibility
[*] Fixes to major crash issues
[/list]
[h1]February Update[/h1]

This update will act as a sneak peek at what the Season update in March will bring.

[h2]New Breaker : Quake[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/e72435a0e12b69670aa6849b6b06f264d77f2617.png[/img]

Quake will be made available with the February update for free.
During this period, we hope to receive lots of good feedback on gameplay and balance before we officially add him in March.

Quake is a fighter type and uses Drill Gauntlet as his starting weapon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/669c33d61af8280b5d649aa3fe4f40b2dfb7ef87.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/9b95a1421fab65bc0f6a738461023c15cf11e552.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/a237d6920fa5e4e9ec2871836e1ee698ac397d52.png[/img]

More details on Quake will come before the February update.

[h2]Season Pass Boost Up[/h2]

After the February update, the VP earned per round will greatly increase to help players obtain Season Pass rewards.

[h2]Preview of Journey Mode[/h2]

We will have the UI for the Journey mode which will be our feature mode for our Season updates available to be seen on the February update. We are still contemplating how much of the content we can expose to playtest before March, but for the meantime, that will be arriving with the Season update on March. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/e388cd14be882cc3bc1955b4c713a5dea526e496.png[/img]

[h1]Season Update[/h1]

Each Season will come with a new Breaker, boss, mission, Toy Worker, relics, skins and Season Pass.
THE RELICS THAT YOU ACQUIRE WILL NOT BE WIPED OUT.

[h1]Season 1 - March[/h1]

[h2]Journey Mode[/h2]
The Journey mode will be the core of our roguelike gameplay. Each season, this mode will be improved upon.
In the journey mode, players are given choices to more actively decide.
[list]
[*] Choose planets to explore ranging from difficulty to upgrade stations
[*] Choose starting weapon
[*] Choose a skill upgrade to start with
[/list]
This will entail the addition of a social process to decide where to journey to in multiplayer mode.
Players will also be able to customize their growth. Players will be able to upgrade weapon / change added effects and sell relics.

At the completion of the Journey, players can find the Prime Vault which contains the trinity relic (tentative name) that are Breaker exclusive relics. These relics can upgrade a breaker skill to a completely new skill. 

[h1]Season 2 - June[/h1]

We will introduce a match/competition mode that friends can compete together.
We will also introduce a new Breaker type called Swordsman.
These Breakers will carry weapons using a blade which includes everything from katanas to sickels.
We will also have a Toy Worker 2.0 update. Toy workers will be able to more actively support players in battle with many special effects ranging from reviving team members to dropping health packs.
Players can also use Crons to upgrade Toy Worker skills and customize them.

[h1]Season 3 - September[/h1]

We plan to introduce a PVP mode. We are still doing R&D on this topic. We tried many different types of PVP including all-out brawl, but we are not sure that is the right color for ANVIL. We will let everyone know once we have a more clear idea.

[h1]Season 4 - December[/h1]

We hope to expand to Nintendo Switch and Playstation with our 1.0 release once we have continually improved.

[h2]Developments in considerations[/h2]

[list]
[*] Diverse Season Achievements : We plan to diversify achievements possible like clearing a certain boss monster with a certain breaker using a certain weapon or healing allies a certain amount.
[*] Season exclusive rankings : We plan to have events with both in-game rewards and prizes so stay tuned!
[*] Addition of elements for competition 
[*] Increase to number of players in a game : We tried having maps with 9~10 people but still refining them. At the current state of Czerny, Symphonia and Campanella, the map is too small to allow more than 3 people. However for premade parties, we are open to allowing four people in a run if they wish to do so. We will make a mode where more people can join in the near future.
[*] Gameplay history log : This is something that is definitely going to be added soon
[/list]

We want to be a great, fun game to play. We will constantly update and refine our game. Our number one goal is for players to have fun and enjoy the game. Wish us luck. 

Since this post became more lengthy than expected, we will upload the Q&As in a separate announcement!

Thanks!

notes.title: December Update Details
notes.content:
[h3]Improvements to sudden deaths[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changes to laser attack pattern application
- The amount of damage received on the initial hit has decreased, but will now additionally apply damage over time
[*]0.1 second Invulnerability after knockback has been added
- Invulnerability period added to ensure no sudden death occurs while standing back up after knockback
[*] Attack increase depending on the number of players in game has been reduced. (Check galaxy balance changes)
[*] Fixed slight delay that occurred before death due to death effects taking place
[/list]

[h3]Improvements to hit effect / feedback[/h3]
[list]
[*] Breaker HP gauge can now be seen more clearly
[*] Sound effect added when Breakers are hit
[*] Camera shake added for auto-attacks
[*] Sound effect added when enemies are hit
[*] Damage HUD effect added when enemies are hit
[*] Push back effect added when enemies are hit
[/list]
[h2]Breakers[/h2]

[h3]Jungler Enhancements[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/52baeab26646e8f8786a5c8885a6cf396e0755e7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/db3ee400d7c44cad80efe1d210b01ba36040d14a.png[/img][/url]
Overall increase to skill power. Now easier to synergize skills to increase damage, allowing for more interesting gameplay.
[list]
[*] [Explosive Mine], [Crossfire] basic damage increase by 20%
[*] Skill Upgrade>[Explosive Mine] : 300% -> 500% increase to damage
[*] Skill Upgrade>[Explosive Mine] : Burn effect increased by 2 times in duration and damage -> additional effect of damage to burned targets increased by 100% for 10 seconds on use
[*] Skill Upgrade>[Explosive Mine] : Create decoy -> additional effect: now increase all skill power by 50% for 10 seconds
[*] Skill Upgrade>[Crossfire] : Skill power increased by 50->200%
[*] Skill Upgrade>[Crossfire] : Increase damage to burned targets by 100% -> increase all skill power by 100%
[/list]
[h3]Sandman Enhancements[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/a53cf532a6ee122c0c6a54fbec968272d360fb22.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/ff9ef719213e52a31194f103e020db9f512e0313.png[/img][/url]
The basic [Slow Dash] now has additional effect of petrification. Sandman can now have more stability in fighting enemies and can easily access petrification synergy. Additionally, skill upgrades allow easier weapon power increase, allowing for easier weapon power build-up.
[list]
[*] [Slow Dash] – Petrifies all colliding enemies
[*] Skill Upgrade> [Tornado Grenade] petrifies target on hit -> now gives additional 50% weapon power for 10 seconds
[*] Skill Upgrade> [Tornado Grenade] increase radius and duration by 100% -> additionally increases damage inflicted on enemies within radius by 25%
[*] Skill Upgrade> [Sand Sniper Shot] Increase damage to petrified targets by 100% -> additionally increase weapon power by 50%
[*] Skill Upgrade> [Power Shield] Increase effect and duration by 2 times -> additionally grants 2 times weapon power
[*] Skill Upgrade> [Slow Dash] petrify enemies in path -> Since petrification is now a base skill effect, this upgrade changes to immediately refill magazine and increase skill power by 5 seconds.
[*] Skill Upgrade> [Slow Dash] Summon petrifying sand tornado on perfect dodge -> sand tornado increases in size, critical chance increase by 50% for 10 seconds
[/list]
[h2]Relics[/h2]

[h3]Explosion Scope bug fix[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/c6ce6dcc32e45bca8b90eda41517996544319c8a.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed where damage applied was based off target attack power instead of Breaker attack power. (Previously dealt more damage the stronger the enemy)
[/list]
[h3]Enhancements to Explosion Scope[/h3]
[list]
[*] 1% Chance to apply 1000%->2000% of Breaker attack as damage
[/list]
[h3]Bug fix to Defense Suit of Retaliation[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/b92e455bae64476645ceb359311a1499e2f09c0d.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Attack damage from relic effect is now applied to final attack power instead of base attack power.
[/list]
[h3]Relic Buff[/h3]
[list]
[*] King of Hearts - Now needs 20 or more relics in possession from 30
[*] Heal Scope - From stack 3, now has 1% chance to apply 500%->1000% of Breaker attack as damage
[*] Explosion Defender – Deal 2000%->3000% of attack power to nearby enemies when receiving knockback
[/list]

[h3]New relic [Lightweight Magazine] added[/h3]
[list]
[*] 5 stack relic that increases attack speed
[*] Base effect of increasing 15% attack speed
[*] Additional effect from 3rd stack to 5th, weapon power increase by 30%, 60%, 90%
[*] Lightweight Magazine makes hit-based weapons more powerful and synergizes well with hit on effect relics and relics like the infinite magazine. Supports attack ability of Shooter and Technician type Breakers.
[/list]

[h3]Description for ammo based relics added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Application status on melee / Cannon type weapons clearly stated
[/list]
[h3]Negative effects on relics now have a different color[/h3]
[list]
[*] Example) A relic that caps max HP at 30% now will be emphasized in color
[/list]
[h3]Changes to relic icons[/h3]
[list]
[*] Close Ranged / Ranged Defense Suit : Change to defense suit icons
[*] Special Charge Module : Change to skill core icon
[*] Greaves / Speed-up Greaves : Change to Greave icon
[/list]
[h3]Changes to the ordering of relics[/h3]
[list]
[*] Relics with similar abilities are now easier to see
[/list]

[h3]Galaxy balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] All enemy HP bar decrease by 20% in single-player mode
[*] Enemy attack power decrease by 20% in Czerny 2 player mode
[*] Enemy attack power decrease by 30% in Symphonia 3 player mode
[/list]

[h3]Improvements to Alert Level system[/h3]

notes.title: December Update Preview
notes.content:
Hello, this is Wonho Son, PD for Anvil.

After starting our Early Access service, the dev team received a lot of feedback and is spending a hectic December. Although there was one emergency patch, there are still many things that need to be fixed. For the moment, we plan to concentrate on stabilizing the game. We are fixing bugs and finding balancing problems that can be fixed step by step. Although everything cannot be fixed in one go, we will constantly strive to gradually become a better game.
 
[h3]Breaker Rework[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/52baeab26646e8f8786a5c8885a6cf396e0755e7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/db3ee400d7c44cad80efe1d210b01ba36040d14a.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/a53cf532a6ee122c0c6a54fbec968272d360fb22.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/ff9ef719213e52a31194f103e020db9f512e0313.png[/img][/url]
Jungler and Sandman are getting buffs. While the two breakers also had stat problems, the main problem was that the skill upgrades were bland and did not have a defining strong point. We will make the basic skills stronger and massively improve their skill upgrades.
 
[h3]Fix to relic bugs[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/c6ce6dcc32e45bca8b90eda41517996544319c8a.png[/img]
The Explosion Scope damage calculation was applied differently than intended so it will be fixed.
However, the damage will be twice as strong.
[list]
[*] Currently : Applies 1000% of enemy’s attack
[*] Change : Applies 1000% -> 2000% of Breaker’s attack
[/list] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251366/b92e455bae64476645ceb359311a1499e2f09c0d.png[/img]
The calculation error of Defense Suit of Retaliation will be fixed.
[list]
[*] Currently : Additional attack power from relic added to base attack power
[*] Change : Additional attack power from relic added to final attack power
[/list] 
[list]
[*] To help understand how our calculations work, The current stat increase system in ANVIL adds % increases to base stats. For example, if basic attack power is 200, acquiring a 10% increase to attack would make it 220. If you acquire another 10%, the 10% of 200 will be added for a total of 240 instead of 10% of 220.
[*] The Defense Suit of Retaliation had a bug of adding attack damage to the base stat, making the final damage much stronger, making this fix come through.
[/list]
These two changes for the relics weren’t fixes for balance but bug fixes. Although the current builds that people might be using could be less effective, we felt these weren’t issues we can ignore and felt the need to fix these when considering all the relic effects in the long term. As the Explosion Scope is a core relic for Lightning’s skill build, we doubled the effect so that it remains useful.

[h3] Clarification to relic description[/h3]
The relic descriptions will additionally show in detail where the effects are applied. To start, the relic description regarding ammunition has been reinforced.
 
[h3]Exploration balance update[/h3]
Difficulty will be made easier in single-player mode.
Enemy attacks will be less powerful in 2~3 player mode.
Some enemy skill damages that were problematic will be tweaked.
 
[h3]Improvement to hit effect/feedback[/h3]
Improving hit effect/feedback isn’t an issue we can solve in a short period of time. We will apply those that we can right now and regularly apply productional improvements moving forward. Camera shaking effects, hit sound effects, update to health UI, damage HUD, and others are being improved and changed as we test.
 
[h3]Convenient features added[/h3]
 
[h3]When a planet is cleared, the fallen players are automatically revived.[/h3]
Now, you don’t have to wait on the cold floor without doing anything, waiting to go to the next planet.
 
[h3]You can check galaxy progress in your stat display.[/h3]
You can now easily check what theme planet is coming and which boss monster is up ahead. You can also check in multiplayer lobby as well so you can decide your Breakers after finding out what the final boss will be.
 
[h3]Change to ping button location[/h3]
As players accidentally clicked the ping button by mistake during fights, we changed the default key to the + button.
 
[h3]Ranking reset[/h3]
The Ranking Leaderboard will be reset entirely. This is intended to give a fair start to users who did or didn't take advantage of the relic bug.
 
[h3]Response to many bugs and errors[/h3]
We are continuously investigating black screen issues, crashing during matchmaking, and other technical problems. Build-updates to address these issues can happen without notice.
If you are experiencing technical problems, reporting to the #bug channel on our official Discord (https://discord.com/invite/anvil) in detail will greatly help us solve the problem.
 
The December update will take place in 1~2 weeks. We will try to apply the update on Steam and Xbox simultaneously, which makes us unable to set a precise date. We appreciate your understanding.
 
Besides the December update, the ANVIL dev team is preparing diverse content and developing new challenge modes. We appreciate all the feedback and support that help us become a better game. Thank you.
